wire.aida_cadence.interval_hours.label.role: Aida settings numeric row label in TUI and connected settings UI
wire.aida_cadence.interval_hours.label.note: Whole elapsed hours, not wall-clock hours. Zero keeps the existing daily time. English-only until independently translated and audited; missing namespaces use English fallback. No ICU arguments.

wire.aida_cadence.interval_hours.help.role: Aida settings row explanation and numeric editor help
wire.aida_cadence.interval_hours.help.tone: direct, reassuring without promising delivery during a pause
wire.aida_cadence.interval_hours.help.note: 1–168 is the inclusive whole-hour bound; 4 is an example, not a default for every user. An owed check-in is preserved on configuration changes. No ICU arguments.
